chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him), which he often called out to his companions:

O my companions, indeed Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will gather the people on the Day of Resurrection, and He will say: I am the King of Kings, and I am the Lord of Lords, and I am Allah; there is no god but Me, so what will you say?
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali warn his companions about regarding the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In this exhortation from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) emphasizes the inevitability of the Day of Judgment as a moment of ultimate accountability, where the transient power of worldly rulers yields to Allah’s absolute sovereignty. This reflection serves as a spiritual anchor for his companions, urging them to align their actions with divine will in preparation for the final reckoning.
